title: Define .tick/runners.toml: schema and documentation
description:
Define the routing config: [orchestrator] (preferred harness/kind), [orchestration] substrate = "herdr"|"harness"|"auto" (default auto) with detection semantics (HERDR_ENV=1 or reachable herdr socket) and explicit graceful fallback to the harness adapter when herdr is requested but unavailable, and [roles.<implement|review|plan|...>] -> kind + args (+ optional tier variants economy/balanced/strong). Deliver a JSON Schema under schemas/ for the TOML structure plus a documentation section (new file skills/ticks/references/runners-config.md) with worked examples: single-vendor, cross-vendor (codex implement + claude review), forced-harness. Do not edit herdr-runner.md or agent-runner.md (owned by other ticks).
Test: example configs in the doc validate against the schema (script or manual jq/tomllib check recorded in notes).
acceptance_criteria: Schema file + runners-config.md exist; substrate detection/fallback semantics unambiguous; all worked examples validate
closed_reason: Completed: runners-config.schema.json + runners-config.md — substrate herdr|harness|auto with detection/fallback semantics, role/tier routing, 3 validated worked examples; schema ships with the skill (schemas/ is Go↔TS codegen-only)
